title: lactuca winkleri
intro: Lactuca winkleri, commonly known as Winkler's milk thistle, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family. Research has shown that Lactuca winkleri possesses various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating symptoms associated with liver and gallbladder disorders. Bioactive constituents of Lactuca winkleri include flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
